name: vision_gan_bad
title: The same DCGAN / WGAN-GP project with nine planted defects
origin: domain-vision round 1: the dirty twin of vision_gan

expected.defect: the discriminator's Sequential ends in nn.Sigmoid while the objective is nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss
expected.why: the sigmoid is applied twice, so the discriminator's gradient vanishes as soon as it is even slightly confident and the generator never receives a useful signal

expected.defect: the whole critic update sits inside a with torch.no_grad() block, so backward() runs with autograd disabled
expected.why: it raises RuntimeError on the first batch - a hard failure, not a slow drift

expected.defect: opt_g is never zeroed - only opt_d is
expected.why: the generator update is the running sum of every generator gradient in the epoch, so the generator diverges while the discriminator trains normally
expected.gap: ISSUE_RULES 3/MLV201 false-positive note (b) suppresses the rule whenever any zero_grad appears in the loop, which the multi-optimizer GAN guard makes unconditional: opt_d.zero_grad() at line 87 silences the missing opt_g.zero_grad(). The guard is documented, so this is a designed blind spot, not an implementation miss.

expected.defect: the only training loader in the DCGAN trainer does not shuffle
expected.why: ImageFolder lists by class directory, so the discriminator sees one identity at a time and mode-collapses along the file order

expected.defect: the real batch is never moved to the device the networks live on
expected.why: a CPU tensor fed to a CUDA module raises at the first forward

expected.defect: the discriminator's running loss is accumulated as a live tensor
expected.why: the autograd graph of every batch is retained for the whole epoch

expected.defect: the generator's running loss is accumulated as a live tensor
sample_grid() no longer calls netG.eval() and is no longer decorated @torch.no_grad()
expected.why: the generator's BatchNorm2d layers use batch statistics of the fixed-noise grid and then keep those running statistics, so the sample grid and the next training step disagree about the same weights
expected.gap: sample_grid() is neither a loop over a LOADER nor a name in MLV301's eval-function regex, so a GAN sampler left in train mode (BatchNorm in batch-statistics mode) is out of reach.

expected.defect: the whole generator module is pickled instead of its state_dict
expected.why: the checkpoint carries the class path and stops loading when models.py moves

forbidden.why: opt_d.step() before loss_g.backward() is the legitimate two-optimiser ordering, not a defect - the same guard the clean twin relies on
the critic and the generator are two separate optimisation problems
both opt_c and opt_g are zeroed in their own half of the step
the WGAN loader still passes shuffle=True
there is no evaluation loader in this project
the loader is built inside build_loader(), reached only from train() under the __main__ guard
there is no softmax and no CrossEntropyLoss in this project
seed_everything() still seeds every source in both trainers
there is no split in this project
every nn.Module subclass still calls super().__init__()
every submodule stack is still an nn.Sequential

gaps.what: the discriminator is fed the undetached fake batch (netD(fake_images) rather than netD(fake_images.detach())), so every discriminator step back-propagates into the generator as well - no rule covers the detach discipline of an adversarial step
the gradient penalty is computed against undetached fakes, so the second-order graph reaches the generator on every critic step
